LARATA-BLOODSMITH_POWER.title: Bloodsmith
LARATA-ROYAL_DAMAGE_RAMP_POWER.title: Royal Momentum
LARATA-ROYAL_DAMAGE_RAMP_POWER.descripti: Deals {Current}% of normal move damage. Next round: {Next}%. Stops increasing at 100%.
LARATA-ROYAL_DAMAGE_RAMP_POWER.capped.de: Deals 100% of normal move damage. Royal Momentum no longer increases.
LARATA-LAST_LAUGH_POWER.title: Last Laugh
LARATA-LAST_LAUGH_POWER.description: Whenever you draw a Status or Curse, gain {Amount} Block and draw {Cards} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
LARATA-COURT_OF_CINDERS_POWER.descriptio: The first time you Exhaust a card each turn, apply {Amount} Poison to ALL enemies.
LARATA-COURT_OF_CINDERS_POWER.title: Court of Cinders
LARATA-ROYAL_COURT_OF_CINDERS_POWER.desc: The first royal Exhaust each turn applies 5 Poison to ALL players. Does not stack.
LARATA-ROYAL_INTERVENTION_POWER.descript: La Rata will play an unknown card before the enemies act. Defeat this marked enemy before then to cancel it.
LARATA-ROYAL_INTERVENTION_POWER.title: The King's Gambit
LARATA-ROYAL_REGALIA_POWER.title: Royal Regalia
LARATA-ROYAL_SECOND_SHADOW_POWER.descrip: Gain 1 Block after each further royal card. This indirect Block is not reduced or co-op scaled. Does not stack.
LARATA-ROYAL_SECOND_SHADOW_POWER.title: Royal Second Shadow
LARATA-ROYAL_SMUGGLERS_DIVIDEND_POWER.de: The first active royal discard each turn grants 3 Vigor. Hand cleanup does not count. Does not stack.
LARATA-SMUGGLERS_DIVIDEND_POWER.descript: Whenever you discard a card, gain {Amount} Vigor.
LARATA-SMUGGLERS_DIVIDEND_POWER.title: Smuggler's Dividend
LARATA-STURDY_TWIST_POWER.title: Sturdy
LARATA-KEEN_TWIST_POWER.title: Keen
LARATA-KEEN_TWIST_POWER.description: Twist: +{Amount}% base attack damage. Included in this enemy's attack intents.
LARATA-EMPOWERED_TWIST_POWER.title: Empowered
LARATA-EMPOWERED_TWIST_POWER.description: Twist: Strength grants of 1 to 3 from this enemy grant 1 additional Strength. Its opening 2 Vigor is shown separately.
LARATA-REINFORCEMENT_TWIST_POWER.title: Reinforcement
LARATA-REINFORCEMENT_TWIST_POWER.descrip: Reinforcement: {Amount}% of normal Max HP and {AttackPercent}% base attack damage. Other twists apply separately.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.title: Twisted Move
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.description: An additional effect repeats after this enemy's marked move. No hit is required.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.unbound.descripti: No compatible move is available. This extra move effect is inactive.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.echoing_unbound.d: Its Weak, Frail and Vulnerable applications of 1 to 3 gain 1 stack (cap 3). No compatible move is available for the extra debuff.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.echoing.title: Echoing
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.echoing.descripti: After its marked move, applies {Debuff} to its player targets with fewer than 2 stacks. Its Weak, Frail and Vulnerable applications of 1 to 3 gain 1 stack (cap 3). Repeats; no hit required.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.hexed.title: Hexed
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.hexed.description: After its marked move, apply {Dose} {Debuff} to its player targets (cap 3). Repeats; no hit required.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.venomous.title: Venomous
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.venomous.descript: After its marked move, apply {Dose} Poison to its player targets (cap 6). Repeats; no hit required.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.ominous.title: Ominous
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.ominous.descripti: After its marked move, apply {Dose} Doom to its player targets (cap 25% of their Max HP). Repeats; no hit required.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.cinders.title: Cinders
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.cinders.descripti: After its marked move, shuffle 1 Burn into each player target's draw pile. Repeats; no hit required.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.disorienting.desc: After its marked move, shuffle 1 Dazed into each player target's draw pile. Repeats; no hit required.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.lacerating.title: Lacerating
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.lacerating.descri: After its marked move, add 1 Wound to each player target's discard pile. Repeats; no hit required.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.shackling.title: Shackling
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.shackling.descrip: After its marked move, give its player targets 1 temporary Strength reduction (cap 1). Repeats; no hit required.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.sapping.title: Sapping
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.sapping.descripti: After its marked move, reduce its player targets' Dexterity by 1 if above -1. Repeats; no hit required.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.constricting.desc: After its marked move, apply {Dose} Constrict to its player targets (cap 4). Repeats; no hit required.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.eroding.title: Eroding
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.eroding.descripti: After its marked move, apply 1 Disintegration to its player targets (cap 2). Repeats; no hit required.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.doomweaver.title: Doomweaver
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.doomweaver.descri: After its marked move, apply 2 Doom to its player targets (cap 25% of their Max HP). Repeats; no hit required. Its Shroud is shown separately.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.leaden.title: Leaden
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.leaden.descriptio: After its marked move, add 1 Slimed to each player target's discard pile. Repeats; no hit required.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.statichex.title: Static Hex
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.statichex.descrip: After its marked move, shuffle 1 Void into each player target's draw pile. Repeats; no hit required.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.crossfire.title: Crossfire
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.crossfire.descrip: After its marked move, apply 1 Weak and 1 Vulnerable to its player targets (cap 2 each). Repeats; no hit required.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.sundering.title: Sundering
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.sundering.descrip: After the marked move, remove up to 6 Block from each target.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.purifying.title: Purifying
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.purifying.descrip: After the marked move, remove one Debuff from this enemy.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.mending.title: Mending
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.mending.descripti: After the marked move, heal up to 3 HP, limited to 5% Max HP (minimum 1).
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.entangling.title: Entangling
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.entangling.descri: After the marked move, target Attack cards cost 1 more next turn. Does not stack.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.withering.title: Withering
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.withering.descrip: After the marked move, targets draw 1 fewer card next turn, then this effect expires. Does not stack.
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.shriveling.title: Shriveling
LARATA-HEX_TWIST_POWER.shriveling.descri: After the marked move, targets deal 30% less attack damage next turn. Does not stack; ends when this enemy dies.
LARATA-TWIST_VARIETY.sheltered.descripti: Takes at most {Amount} damage per hit.
LARATA-TWIST_VARIETY.reactive.descriptio: Gains {Amount} Block after each Attack card played by a player.
LARATA-WITHERING_POWER.title: Withering
LARATA-WITHERING_POWER.description: Draw 1 fewer card at the start of your next turn, then remove this effect. Does not stack.
